dedupe_keys.name: miljøgis data downloads danish climate adaptation natura 2000 and river basin plan layers

description: This page of the Danish Environmental Protection Agency offers downloads of the larger datasets shown in its MiljøGIS web maps. For climate adaptation it gives layers based on the 2016 national elevation model: imperviousness, groundwater, coast and sea level rise from 0.1 to 7 metres in bands of one metre, and further climate adaptation data, such as calculations from the 2007 elevation model, watercourses, groundwater and rainfall, through WMS, WMTS and WFS links. For Natura 2000 plans and for river basin management plans (from the 2021 to 2027 plans to the basic analysis for 2027 to 2033) it provides GIS data as WMS, WFS and downloads in MapInfo and ArcGIS formats, from the agency's GeoServer and GeoWebCache. The page states that the data come from various sources, that the agency is not liable for errors, that the data are only indicative, and that plan data are static and historical except for the plan in force, with updated data on the Danish Environmental Portal. Access is free; no licence is named on the page read. Caveats: the page is in Danish and several layers are not updated. Coverage is Denmark. It supports hazard exposure and climate adaptation analysis, such as screening roads, utilities and buildings against sea level rise and cloudburst layers; related records are Kystdata and the Danish high water statistics.
